description:
🌙 CreateMineRepeat — a server for Minecraft (Bedrock)

A server from Québec, run by a team in Montréal. A dark, always-night hub… and games made by players.

🛠️ Build your own mini-game, with zero code: our team built custom creation items. Make your game, submit it to our OPs, and it gets published for the whole server. Approved creators (18+, or through a parent/guardian) can receive a share of their game's sales under a written agreement.

🧪 Help us pick the next tools: we're starting with a handful of creation items and adding more over time, often based on creator ideas. Early creators get to shape the server.

🎮 Modes

- Plots: claim your plot and home with the compass.

- Survival: classic, with friends.

- PvP Kits: Dark Citadel and Void Arena, with Archer, Tank, Assassin, Mage, Necromancer/Druid (summons) kits. All kits are free.

- Community games: new games published regularly.

✅ Free · All ages · No pay-to-win · No crates/loot boxes · Online 24/7 · Low ping for eastern Canada & US · Public prices: https://createminerepeat.com/regles-et-prix.html

📍 Address: createminerepeat.playit.plus · Port: 3223 · Discord: https://discord.gg/uje3S5kdft · Contact: contact@createminerepeat.com

— FR —

Serveur québécois basé à Montréal : crée tes mini-jeux sans coder, publie-les après révision par nos OP, et joue à ceux de la communauté. Parcelles, Survie, PvP Kits gratuits. Aide-nous à choisir les prochains outils ! Gratuit, tous publics, aucun avantage payant.
